ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Potential Corruption in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate potential corruption in Minnesota, including the handling of ICE protests and the investigation into Governor Walz and Mayor Frey.
ideas.angle: The story would follow the money trail to uncover any potential wrongdoing by public officials.
questions: What is the extent of the corruption in Minnesota?
How did the governor and mayor handle ICE protests?
ideas.insight: I believe that following the money trail will reveal a larger pattern of corruption in Minnesota, potentially involving multiple public officials and entities. This story has the potential to expose significant wrongdoing and bring about accountability.
